test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In relation to the state of Tamil Nadu, the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Act, 2022 will include the __________ and Kurivikkaran communities in the list of Scheduled Tribes in Tamil Nadu.
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Act, 2022 includes the **Narikoravan** and Kurivikkaran communities in the list of Scheduled Tribes in Tamil Nadu.
 
• The inclusion of these communities aims to provide them with the benefits and protections available to Scheduled Tribes under the Constitution of India.
 
• This amendment is part of the ongoing efforts to recognize and support the diverse tribal communities in the country.
 
• Scheduled Tribes are provided with various affirmative action measures including reservations in education, employment, and political representation to ensure their development and integration into mainstream society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India provides a detailed framework for the recognition and protection of Scheduled Tribes through various articles and schedules.
 
• Article 342 of the Constitution deals with the specification of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• The President of India, in consultation with the Governor of the respective state, is empowered to specify the tribes or tribal communities to be included in the list of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• Periodic amendments are made to the list to include or exclude communities based on socio-economic criteria and recommendations from state governments and other stakeholders.
 
• The inclusion of a community in the Scheduled Tribes list allows its members to avail various constitutional safeguards and welfare measures aimed at their socio-economic upliftment.
